stories.title: Define GPTReader and Manifest Schema Contracts
stories.description: Define and standardize request/response schema for GPTReader including query limits, pagination, manifest reference requirements, and audit fields to enforce consistent contracts across Brain components.

stories.title: Implement GPTReader Reliability and Guardrails
stories.description: Enhance GPTReader with strict enforcement of 500KB response cap, 100-document limits, retry logic, timeout handling, and deterministic error responses to ensure stable and predictable behavior.

stories.title: Expose Manifest-Aware Read Interface
stories.description: Implement an internal API layer that requires all GPTReader queries to resolve against manifest entries, enforcing traceability, file-level validation, and alignment with manifest-generated capabilities.

stories.title: GPTReader Unit and Integration Test Suite Expansion
stories.description: Expand unit and integration tests to cover limit enforcement, manifest resolution, auth validation, failure modes, and end-to-end query flows using real manifest snapshots.

stories.title: Standardize Audit Logging and Cross-Service Consistency
stories.description: Standardize GPTReader audit logs to include manifest references, query metadata, response size, and error states, and ensure consistency with broader Brain audit patterns for downstream QA, SIT, and compliance validation.
